correctness.rationale: The F_2^3 subspace lattice gives one isolated zero vertex, seven point vertices and seven plane vertices. The point/plane Gram construction has exact rank 7 and the packaged explicit forcing trace proves Z<=8, so M=Z=8 and mr=7. Exhaustive enumeration of all 2^15 subsets gives every polynomial coefficient, and all 168 matrices of GL(3,2) are enumerated to obtain a complete ten-orbit partition of the 1204 minimum sets.

value.rationale: The F_2^3 case is a canonical smallest projective-plane module-intersection graph. The accepted result is a natural complete finite classification: full zero forcing polynomial, exact maximum nullity and minimum rank, all 1204 minimum sets, and their ten GL(3,2) symmetry types.
